text:
nina-sales: Quick ask from client RedwoodMall: 3-day POC to replace their legacy streaming endpoint with our SDK. Requirements: structured JSON responses, one tool call to fraud-check, minimal code changes. Any red flags?
omar-se: No major blockers. Recommend a one-file shim to map their existing call signature to our streaming SDK. Biggest risks: connection semantics and ensuring no dropped messages during cutover.
julia-ml: For continuity we should warm KV caches and run a short fan-out phase (mirror requests to both systems) while deduping on request-id. Also need their JSON schema + 10 gold examples.
paul-devex: Security: provide ephemeral scoped keys (TTL 1h) and HMAC-signed webhook for tool callbacks. For demo, stub the fraud API in our sandbox to avoid sharing creds. I'll add a rotation script.
nina-sales: They asked about cost if we pre-warm nodes. Can we do hosted without Dedicated?
omar-se: Yes, hosted first. Pre-warm via synthetic replay. Cost depends on tokens; ask them to share 50 sample requests.
julia-ml: Rough token calc: avg 60 tokens/request -> 50 rps ~ 180k tokens/min. Factor ~1.15 for function-call overhead.
paul-devex: Small cURL example for non-SDK path (stream + function call):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"stream":true,"model":"redwood-small","functions":[{"name":"fraud_check","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}}]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
SDK is recommended for reconnects and callbacks.
infra-bot: POC ticket created: POC-11011. Demo cluster target: 2025-05-15T09:00:00Z.
nina-sales: Action items: Omar -> shim and dedupe plan; Julia -> token sim + acceptance tests; Paul -> stub + rotation script; I'll confirm schedule with customer. I'll ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
